BiblicalUsage: The ninth — the ninth hour of prayer, when Peter and John went up to the temple in Acts 3:1, and the ninth foundation stone of the New Jerusalem, a topaz, in Revelation 21:20.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God marks ordinary hours and ordinary stones — the ninth hour became the hour of a lame man's healing, and the ninth stone shines in the city that never needs a temple.
